title: L'Occitane Group to offload Elemis to PAI Partners
summary: L'Occitane is selling British skincare brand Elemis, a premium British skincare brand established in 1989, to French private equity firm PAI Partners, which plans to accelerate the brand's growth in the United States, both companies announced on November 4. The transaction, the financial terms of which have not been disclosed, is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary regulatory approvals, according to a press release. title: Celebrity British hairstylist John Frieda dies aged 75
summary: British celebrity hairstylist and beauty industry stalwart John Frieda, who tended to the locks of Jackie Kennedy and Princess Diana among others, has died aged 75, his salon announced on Tuesday, November 3. "It is with heavy hearts that we share the news that our dear John passed away peacefully... surrounded by his family," the John Frieda salon posted on Instagram. title: Estée Lauder accelerates turnaround and targets higher margins by 2030
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies reported a 7% increase in net sales in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, ended September 30, 2026, exceeding analysts' expectations of around 5% growth. Building on this momentum, the US cosmetics group is raising its full-year guidance and setting new growth and operating margin targets for 2030 as it continues its turnaround.
